available.meaning: The courier knows that shipments depart every Tuesday and Thursday at 4:00 PM America/Los_Angeles.
available.name: shipment schedule

available.meaning: The courier knows that transit time is about 3 hours.
available.name: transit time

not_available.meaning: The courier does not have information about the blood centre's collection rate or current inventory levels.
not_available.name: collection rate or inventory levels

send_receive_mechanism.meaning: The courier receives shipments from the blood centre at its location and delivers them to St. Vincent regional hospital. Communication is not specified; presumably the courier is dispatched by the centre.

process_behavior.meaning: The courier transports shipments from the blood centre to St. Vincent regional hospital. Each shipment takes about 3 hours from departure to receipt at the hospital.
process_behavior.operating_meaning: The courier operates on Tuesdays and Thursdays, departing at 4:00 PM America/Los_Angeles, and arriving approximately 3 hours later.
process_behavior.rate_meaning: Not applicable; the courier does not have a rate, it transports fixed-size shipments on a fixed schedule.

authority.meaning: Hospital receives and holds blood units; does not control collection or shipping schedule

channels.latency_meaning: About 3 hours from departure to receipt
channels.meaning: Physical delivery of blood units by courier
channels.name: courier_delivery

initial_state.meaning: Usable blood units held at start of week
initial_state.name: initial_stock

knows.meaning: Hospital knows its own initial stock
knows.name: initial_stock

knows.meaning: Hospital knows shipments arrive Tuesdays and Thursdays around 7 PM
knows.name: shipment_schedule

initial_state.meaning: The number of blood units in the Tuesday shipment.
initial_state.name: shipment_units

initial_state.meaning: The time the Tuesday shipment departs from the centre.
initial_state.name: departure_time

initial_state.meaning: The time taken for the shipment to travel from centre to hospital.
initial_state.name: travel_duration

process_behavior.meaning: The courier transports the Tuesday shipment from the blood centre to St. Vincent regional hospital, taking about 3 hours. The shipment arrives at the hospital and is received into its bank.
process_behavior.operating_meaning: Departs at 4:00 PM America/Los_Angeles on Tuesday, arrives approximately 3 hours later, i.e., around 7:00 PM America/Los_Angeles.
process_behavior.rate_meaning: One shipment per Tuesday, carrying 150 units.

initial_state.meaning: The number of usable blood units in the Thursday shipment.
initial_state.name: shipment_quantity

initial_state.meaning: The time the Thursday shipment departs the centre.
initial_state.name: departure_time

initial_state.meaning: The time taken for the shipment to reach the hospital and be received.
initial_state.name: travel_duration

process_behavior.meaning: The courier transports the Thursday shipment from the blood centre to St. Vincent regional hospital, taking about 3 hours.
process_behavior.operating_meaning: Departs Thursday at 4:00 PM America/Los_Angeles, arrives approximately 3 hours later, i.e., around 7:00 PM America/Los_Angeles.
process_behavior.rate_meaning: One shipment of 150 units per Thursday.
